title: TrashTally: an audit of India's municipal solid waste figures (data release 2026-11-10)
description: State and UT figures for municipal solid waste in India (tonnes per day), transcribed from published CPCB and MoHUA documents and parliamentary answers, with the source document and page for every row, plus rules that flag figures that cannot all be true. Figures are reproduced as printed and are not corrected or estimated; missing values stay blank. CPCB and MoHUA figures mostly describe different years and may define 'treated' and 'processed' differently; see docs/methodology.md and the definition crosswalk. The underlying figures belong to the publishing bodies; reuse terms for each source are summarised in docs/licences.md. The release contains no copies of the source documents. The authors are not affiliated with, and are not endorsed by, the Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha Secretariat, CPCB or MoHUA.
